subscription.title: GifOS plans
subscription.intro: Public majority-rules meetings (open meetings) are always free.
subscription.noAccount: No accounts, ever. Your plan lives on your devices, and if you ever lose them, restore it with the PayPal account you paid with.
subscription.upgradeNow: A bigger plan replaces yours. Its first charge is smaller: we take off a credit for the unused time of your current plan. Every charge after that is the full price.
subscription.upgradeCancel: We cancel the plan it replaces as soon as the new one starts, so you are never billed twice.
subscription.upgradePass: A four-hour pass is never cancelled: it keeps running beside any plan.
subscription.fileNote: Your plan lives in this browser. Keep a copy: download your subscription file here, or choose Copy my plan to another device on gifos.app/subscription.

subscription.free.name: Free
subscription.free.desc: Unlimited majority-rules meetings (open meetings) with unlimited people. Pick any name, share the link, and everyone's in, whether it's ten people or thousands. The meeting grows with the crowd because it runs between the people in it, not on our servers. Talk, chat, react, share your screen, bring apps and AI agents. Free, forever.
subscription.free.desc2: Hosted meetings of up to 5 people, one meeting at a time. Voice and chat get through corporate and school firewalls, still end-to-end encrypted and no accounts.

subscription.lead: Plans for GifOS Meet and Broadcast: bigger meetings, video that gets through corporate and school firewalls, still end-to-end encrypted, and My library for your recordings. No accounts, ever.
subscription.heldGet: Have a plan on another device? Get it here
subscription.getHow: On the device that has your plan, open gifos.app/subscription and choose Copy my plan to another device. Scan its code with this device, or open its link here.
subscription.restoreLead: Lost the device that had your plan? Get it back with the PayPal account you paid with.
subscription.howSizes: Anyone in a meeting who holds a plan sizes the whole meeting: the best plan present wins, for as long as its holder is there.
subscription.howFirewall: Free gets voice and chat through corporate and school firewalls; paid plans get video through too, still end-to-end encrypted.
subscription.pendingNote: Checkout not finished: nothing was charged.
subscription.pendingLost: This checkout replaced the plan this browser had. To use that plan here again: open your subscription file, copy the plan from another device that has it, or use Restore with PayPal.

subscription.howPlans: A plan is a set of permissions that works in GifOS apps, today Meet and Broadcast. Each card shows what it gives in each app.
subscription.howRenew: The four-hour pass is paid once and simply ends. Every other plan renews monthly or yearly through PayPal until you cancel it.
subscription.howReceipts: Every payment has a receipt: they are listed under Receipts on this page, and each one is also a receipt GIF in the Purchases folder on your Home Screen.
